=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text first "first 200 cuban primes:\n"
text th "the 100000th cuban prime: "
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note cuban primes here are the primes (n+1)^3 - n^3 = 3n^2 + 3n + 1; the 100000th, 1792617147127, is below 2^41
note mulm is a * b mod m for m < 2^42: b splits into 21-bit halves so each product stays below 2^63
fn mulm a ulong b ulong m ulong to ulong
h = mul a shr b 21
h = rem h m
h = rem shl h 21 m
l = rem mul a and b 0x1fffff m
r = add h l
if ge r m
r = sub r m
end
ret r
end
fn powm b ulong e ulong m ulong to ulong
r = ulong 1
x = rem b m
v = e
while gt v 0 bound 64
if eq and v 1 1
r = mulm r x m
end
x = mulm x x m
v = shr v 1
end
ret r
end
fn sprp n ulong a ulong to bool
d = sub n 1
s = ulong 0
while eq and d 1 0 bound 64
d = shr d 1
s = add s 1
end
x = powm a d n
if or eq x 1 eq x sub n 1
ret true
end
for i ulong sub s 1
x = mulm x x n
if eq x sub n 1
ret true
end
end
ret false
end
note trial division by 2..49 first, then Miller-Rabin to bases 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, which is exact below 3.47 * 10^12
fn isprime n ulong to bool
p = ulong 2
while lt p 50 bound 50
if eq rem n p 0
ret eq n p
end
p = add p 1
end
for k ulong 6
a = ulong 13
if eq k 0
a = 2
end
if eq k 1
a = 3
end
if eq k 2
a = 5
end
if eq k 3
a = 7
end
if eq k 4
a = 11
end
if not sprp n a
ret false
end
end
ret true
end
note bound: the 100000th cuban prime is reached at n = 773019
fn main to int
emit first
c = ulong 0
n = ulong 1
while lt c 100000 bound 999999
v = add mul mul 3 n add n 1 1
if isprime v
c = add c 1
if le c 200
emitu v
if eq rem c 10 0
emit nl
else
emit sp
end
end
if eq c 100000
emit th
emitu v
emit nl
end
end
n = add n 1
end
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
